subject: Post-demo: Security & pen-test follow-up / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Security & pen-test follow-up / next steps

Hi Elena & Rajiv,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the candid discussion about your security needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

1) SOC 2 and compliance posture
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant (most recent reporting period: 2025 calendar year). I can share the report under NDA; see attached placeholder.
- For GDPR/HIPAA: our platform supports data residency controls and customer-managed encryption keys (KMS/HSM). We do not store PHI by default; if you plan to process PHI we'll route you to our Private deployment options and a standard BAAs process.

2) Vendor security questionnaire
- If you'd like to run a questionnaire, please send over the doc (or we can start the standard security questionnaire we use). We can populate the bulk answers and then loop in Security for anything bespoke.

3) Pen test report request & vuln management
- We can provide a recent pen test summary and provide a mechanism to deliver a full redacted report after an NDA.
- Our vulnerability management process: internal scanning cadence (weekly automated scans), quarterly external scans, and an annual third-party penetration test. For customer disclosure we support coordinated disclosure and provide a tracking ticket with remediation ETA.
- SLAs: we treat findings by severity: Critical: 72 hours to initial remediation plan, High: 14 days to remediation plan, Medium/Low: tracked and prioritized per release cadence. We'll include the full policy text if helpful.

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm which security artifacts you want first (SOC 2 report, pen test summary/report, questionnaire).
- If pen test report is required, please confirm whether redacted copy is sufficient or you need full report under NDA. If full report: we'll route to Legal for NDA + DocuSign and share via secure link.
- I'll loop in Rishi (our Security/Compliance lead) to own the questionnaire and coordinate artifacts.

Attaching: redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (redacted stub), pen-test-authorization-form.pdf (for your internal approval if needed)

Happy to hop on a short call if that helps — we can target this week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few questions/notes from our side: 

1) SOC 2: redacted report is fine for initial review. We'll escalate to security once we see the scope.

2) Pen test: we need a redacted report first; if anything critical is present we may request the full report under NDA. Can you confirm the date of Redwood's last third-party pen test and whether you can provide a remediation summary for any High/Critical findings?

3) Vulnerability SLAs: the ranges you suggested look reasonable. For procurement we usually ask for a documented SLA that includes time-to-mitigation and timeframe for verification. Can Rishi send the formal vuln management policy?

4) Questionnaire: I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (VSQL-Redwood-2026.docx). Please populate it and return; we'll mark any exceptions.

If you can provide the items by EOD Wednesday (11th) that would keep us on track for procurement next week.

Thanks,
Elena

Hi Elena — looping in our Security & Compliance lead (Monica) to own the questionnaire and to provide the formal vulnerability management policy. Brief answers inline: 

- Last third-party pen test: Oct 2025 (performed by RedTeamLabs). We can provide a redacted report and a summary of High/Critical findings; none were outstanding as of the post-test verification window.

- Remediation summary: for the 2025 test we had 1 High (privilege escalation path in a non-production service) — this was mitigated within our 14-day SLA and verified via rescans. No Critical findings. We'll provide the remediation ticket IDs and verification evidence in the secure bundle.

- Vulnerability management policy & SLAs: attached is a short policy excerpt. Full policy and SOC controls mapping will be provided via secure Drive link. Our operational cadence: weekly automated scanning (internal), bi-weekly dependency scanning in CI, quarterly external scans, and annual third-party pen test. We aim for 72 hrs to initial triage for Critical, 14 days for High, and tracked resolution for Medium/Low with SLA tied to severity and customer impact.

We'll populate the questionnaire and return it by EOD Wednesday. If you need a faster turnaround for any specific sections let me know.
